commit_message: Keep Claude ACP capability hints transport-compatible
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the Claude-specific ACP discovery, setup, runtime identity, launch metadata, capability metadata, and diagnostics adapter on top of the ACP Foundation branch. Claude descriptor hints now contain only stable provider-neutral capabilities; optional ACP features remain subject to live common-transport negotiation instead of becoming Claude-specific extension requirements. Legacy Claude stream-json and Codex behavior remain unchanged.

## Validation

Authoring subtask only. Heavy Cargo, Windows, and Visual Validation are intentionally deferred to final ACP integration.
